provider: CCHDO (CLIVAR and Carbon Hydrographic Data Office), UC San Diego
format: CF NetCDF-4 (Conventions: CF-1.8 CCHDO-1.0, featureType: profile)
stored_unmodified: Yes - the pristine provider file is kept so the published hash stays verifiable. Subsetting happens downstream in S2/S4, not here.
closes_gap: DIR-005 CTD under the strict reading - standalone ship CTD casts, not a glider-mounted sensor
why_this_is_a_true_CTD_source: Fixed hydrographic stations with expocode, section_id, station and cast identifiers, not a drifting float WMO number
Approximately 1 dbar vertical resolution (mean 3595 levels per in-box profile)
Reaches 3860 dbar, well past the ~2000 dbar Argo limit
Ship-occupied casts on a GO-SHIP repeat hydrography line

within_project_box.science_note: The low oxygen minimum (1.5 umol/kg) is the Arabian Sea oxygen minimum zone, which is the expected signal for this region.

qc_vocabulary: WOCE quality flags in *_qc variables (standard_name: status_flag) - a fourth QC vocabulary alongside core Argo, BGC-Argo and glider QARTOD
note: NetCDF-4/HDF5, not NetCDF-3 classic. The ingestion reader must handle both.
